entities.summary: Fumitaka Konoe  was the eldest son and heir of Prime Minister Fumimaro Konoe and the 13th-generation descendant of Emperor Go-Yōzei. He served as first lieutenant in the Imperial Japanese Army in World War II, and died mysteriously in a Soviet prison.
